about: Time-of-day trigger (#784), dark: the Triggers tab of a new cue (box off, 00:00:00 faint, 24-hour, every day); ticked with 10:30 typed (read as 00:10:30); PM chosen; the days menu open; then 2.2 set to fire at 00:00:05 on Thursdays (the stepped clock's day) and the clock played past it, 2.2 running; then 2.1 and 2.2 selected together (box and clock mixed).
